slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
林灵素哈哈笑道：“谁说老子食言背誓了？蓬莱远在天边，近在眼前，你自己有眼不识泰山，怪得谁来？”
许宣环顾四周，最大的礁石也不过五丈来高，哪来的海岛？大为失望，心想多半让自己误打误撞说着了，这魔头不过是眼见敌我悬殊，施计将王文卿等人诱到这凶险海域，决一生死。
船上众人更是喧哗如沸，高声喝骂。
李少微叹了口气，道：“李郎，刂菌不知晦朔，蟪蛄不知春秋，，和这些没有慧根、慧眼的蠢物又何必罗嗦？那半男不女的王娘子若真有本事，便降下万千雷霆，将我们轰灭了便是。”
王文卿双颊泛起潮红，愤怒已极，徐徐道：“李元君与灵萼兄金童玉女，双剑合璧，据说当年已近天下无敌。在下费了数十年光阴，创此‘五行太一霓电阵，，比起你们的‘两仪雷剑，不知何如？”
指诀变幻，背后长剑“嗡”地一声，银光如电，直破苍穹。
“轰”天海骤亮，闪电乱舞，一道接一道地汇入剑光，霎时间光焰暴涨，炽亮如白昼。
四周“咻咻”破风之声大作，那五艘大船上冲天飞起数百道刺目剑光，层层叠叠地环绕在那“电剑”周围，气浪交撞，陡然怒放出赤、橙、青、黑、白五种光芒，仿佛霓虹吸海，银河倒泄，在空中呼呼怒旋。
许宣、小青大凛，对望一眼，不约而同地朝后撤了几步，想要趁乱溜之大吉。这三个魔头都精擅天雷感应大法，一旦交手，霹雳轰顶，周遭百步之内都必被炸成炭糜。
李少微身子一晃，快如鬼魅，一手扣住小青脉门，另一掌紧紧抵住她的后心，柔声道：“小妖精，风大浪大，想到哪里去？”气浪怒涌，惊涛骇浪似的卷入她的奇经八脉。
小青痛吟一声，汗水涔涔而下，雪肤泛起鳞鳞青光。只要她再用上三分气力，元神便将震荡湮灭，化为蛇形。
许宣喝道：“放开她”正想去拔龙牙刀，又听林灵素笑道：“小子，就凭你这点修为，也能暗算得了她？”双膝酥麻，被他气箭扫中，登时“咚”地一声跪倒在葫芦上。
他又惊又恼，不知这两人为何忽然尽释前嫌，携手相助，大声道：“魔头，你出也出来了，还待怎样？小青姑娘和你无怨无仇，何必拖她下水？要杀要剐，冲我来便是”
林灵素笑道：“小子怜香惜玉，颇有老子的风范，很好，很好。”扣住他的脑袋，朝自己身前按倒，道：“不是我不放你们，是你们自寻死路，脱不了身。要想活命，就跪下给老子磕几个响头，拜我为师。”
许宣奋力挣扎，脖颈却像被铁箍紧紧箍住，林灵素嘿然道：“他奶奶的，天下也不知多少人想入我神霄门下，老子破例收你，你居然还东推西辞。一叩头”
许宣背颈一沉，身不由己地朝他俯身叩了一个响头，羞怒填膺，喝道：“我是葛仙人派外门生，岂能拜你这魔头为师”刚想挥刀猛刺，脉门酸软，龙牙刃又被他劈手夺过。
林灵素森然道：“你当老子想收你为徒么？当日青羊宫内，老子已传了你‘五雷心法，，这心法连王文卿也未曾识全，若不是你对老子有‘半个，救命之恩，早就将你一掌拍死了。既然杀不得你，你就得老老实实做我神霄弟子
话音未落，许宣颈上又是一沉，“嗵嗵”连磕了两个响头，心中气怒得直欲炸将开来，叫道：“魔头你害死明空方丈与葛仙人，害得我满门受累，害得大宋受此浩劫，恶贯满盈，人神共愤，许宣就算雷霆轰顶、葬身鱼腹，也绝不做你爪牙你只管杀了我便是”
林灵素哈哈一笑，道：“老子向来有恩报恩，有仇报仇，岂能做这种恩将仇报的无耻之事？你已经行了拜师之礼，又记诵了五雷心法，已是老子的嫡传弟子。上有贼老天，下有这帮王八蛋，均可为证，想要抵赖也抵赖不了了。”
说话间，空中霓光滚滚，雷鸣不绝。乱剑穿梭飞舞，环绕着那道“电剑”越转越快，幻化出极光似的炫丽奇景，相隔数百丈，却已激得海面巨浪迭起，漩涡频生。

王文卿淡淡道：“阴阳合，雷乃生。这少年是纯阳之身，这蛇妖是至阴之体。两位经脉俱断，油尽灯枯，是想用他们来合炼‘两仪雷剑，么？”
林灵素笑道：“杀鸡焉用牛刀？我和娘子的两仪雷剑是用来斩鬼杀神的，对付你们嘛，这两个小鬼就绰绰有余啦。”
转过头，笑嘻嘻地望着李少微，道：“夫妻阋于床，外御其侮。我的亲亲好娘子，你我斗了几十年，如今老啦，再斗也斗不出什么结果，倒不如比比谁的徒弟更加成器。”
这几句娘子喊得似假还真，李少微眼圈一红，泪珠险些夺眶涌出。明明知道他薄情寡义，明明对他恨之入骨，但听在耳中，想起从前他所说的种种甜言蜜语，想起在一起的快乐光景，仍不免耳根如烧，酸甜苦楚。
她深吸了一口气，嫣然一笑，道：“李郎，李郎，你要我做的事儿，我何时拒绝过你？”捏开小青的口颊，将几颗药丸弹了进去。
小青喉中一凉，如咽寒冰，继而丹田内宛如熔岩喷薄，陡然涌起重重热浪，随着经脉卷遍全身，残余的些许寒意顷刻荡然无存。
李少微撤开双手，柔声道：“丫头，你修炼了五百年，不得要领，始终未能打通任督二脉。这几颗‘上清微香丸，，一则可以激化‘元婴金丹，，解你体内．魄花粉，的寒毒;二则能助你畅通经络。只要你老老实实听我的话，不消一年，就能修至‘人仙，之境……”
小青朝思暮想便是摆脱蛇身，修炼成仙，听说这女魔头有心相助，对她的怨恨登时消了大半，惊喜交加。
李少微顿了顿，又道：“你若不听话，那也由得你，只是这几颗丹丸内的‘三尸金线蛊，一旦发作起来，求生不得，求死不能，到时可别怨我这做师父的不救你。”嘴唇翕动，不知念了句什么咒语。
小青眼前一黑，心中万刀齐剐，疼得险些叫出声来。被她挟持一路，早就见识了这妖后的种种狠辣手段，知她言出必行，咬牙暗想：“留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。横竖这两魔头经脉俱断，强撑不了多久啦。只要今夜保得性命，还怕将来解不了蛊毒、拿不到炼天石图，？”
当下伏身叩首，朝她恭恭敬敬地道：“多谢天后救命之恩。能作上师弟子，乃是小青三生修来的福气，高兴还来不及，怎敢忤逆？”
林灵素笑道：“小子，这妖精可比你乖巧多啦。看来也得让你吃上几只‘应声虫，，才能变得老实一些。”
许宣脸颊一痛，被他捏开口颊，也不知将什么塞了进来，喉中一阵麻痒，果真如同虫子爬过，直落腹中。遍体鸡皮泛起，又惊又怒，却被他掐住双颊无法呕出。
霓光乱舞，风浪越来越大，雷鸣暴雨中，王文卿的声音一字字传来：“五气合，太一成。今日之战，‘太一雷兵，与‘两仪电剑，只有其一能留存于世。当年蒙灵萼兄传授‘无名心法，，我方道有初成。虽然阁下藏私掖秘，害我险些走火入魔，但这初授之恩，王某人一直铭记于心。这前三剑，就算是答谢往日之情。”
话音方落，“轰”地一声，乱剑缤纷，霞光滚滚冲落在半里开外，登时激起数十丈高的滔天巨浪。
葫芦猛地飞旋抛起，撞入层叠狂涛，颠得许宣气血乱涌，七荤八素。
林灵素紧紧抓住他的肩膀，哈哈笑道：“当年神农架上，你口蜜腹剑，老子早就料到会有今日，只是念在结拜之谊，宁君负我，我不负君。从延福宫中，到武夷九曲，再从东海之滨，到九华山颠，你暗算老子的次数何止三次？又何必惺惺作态，让我三剑？”
雷声轰鸣，海面如炸，王文卿的第二剑又已劈落。
这一次落在葫芦左侧，撞起的大浪兜天盖地，足有百丈来高，就连游弋的鲨群也被掀了起来。
小青惊得面色苍白，林灵素却纵声长啸，连呼痛快，双手抵住许宣后背，笑道：“小子，你我早就是一条绳上的蚂蚱了，官家朝廷也罢，道佛各派也罢，都已把你看成老子的同党。还是乖乖地听老子的话，合力杀了这些鞑子和贼道士，说不定还能抵回你爹娘的性命”掌心吐力，将真气绵绵传入。

李少微亦抵住小青后心，让她与许宣对面盘坐，手掌相贴。四人排成直线，随着葫芦在漩涡里急速飞转。
许宣满心气苦，恨不能破口大骂，奈何体内气浪滔滔掀堵，一个字儿也发不出来。
只听那魔头嗡嗡传音道：“意如混沌，气似太虚，炼气化神，炼神化道，三关三田，水火坎离，奇经八脉，息息归根……”真气冲入丹田，如涡轮怒转，衣裳猎猎鼓舞。

content_en:
Lin Lingsu laughed and said: "Who said I broke my promise? Penglai is far away in the horizon and right in front of you. You yourself have eyesight but cannot see Mount Tai. Who is to blame?"
Xu Xuan looked around. The largest reef was only five feet high. Where could it be an island? I was greatly disappointed, thinking that I had probably hit him by mistake. This devil just saw the huge disparity between the enemy and us, and used a trick to lure Wang Wenqing and others into this dangerous sea area to fight for life and death.
Everyone on the boat was even more noisy, shouting and cursing.
Li Shaowei sighed and said: "Li Lang, the chopping bacteria don't know Hui Shuo, and the crickets don't know Spring and Autumn, so why bother with these idiots who have no wisdom or discernment? If the half-man and half-woman Queen Wang is really capable, she will rain down thousands of thunders and destroy us."
Wang Wenqing's cheeks flushed, and he was very angry. He said slowly: "Li Yuanjun and brother Ling'e, the golden boy and the beautiful girl, had two swords together. It is said that they were almost invincible in the world. I spent decades to create this 'Five Elements Taiyi Neon Array'. How does it compare to your 'Liang Yi Thunder Sword?"
The finger gestures changed, and the long sword behind his back buzzed, and the silver light was like lightning, piercing the sky.
"Boom" the sky suddenly brightened, lightning danced wildly, and merged into the sword light one after another. In an instant, the flames surged and were as bright as day.
There was a loud "whoosh" sound in the wind all around, and hundreds of dazzling sword lights flew into the sky from the five large ships, surrounding the "electric sword" layer by layer. The air waves collided and suddenly released five kinds of light: red, orange, green, black and white. It was like neon sucking the sea and the Milky Way leaking, roaring and swirling in the air.
Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing looked at each other and took a few steps back in unison, hoping to take advantage of the chaos and escape. These three demons are all proficient in the method of sensing sky thunder. Once they fight, thunderbolts will strike from the top and everyone within a hundred steps will be blown into charcoal.
Li Shaowei swayed, as fast as a ghost, clasped Xiaoqing's vein gate with one hand, and pressed the other palm tightly against her back, saying softly: "Little fairy, the wind is strong and the waves are strong, where do you want to go?" The waves of energy surged, and rolled into her eight meridians like a stormy sea.
Xiaoqing groaned in pain, sweat poured down his face, and his snowy skin glowed with a blue light. As long as she uses another three points of energy, the soul will annihilate the shock and turn into a snake shape.
Xu Xuan shouted: "Let her go." Just as he was about to pull out the Dragon Tooth Sword, he heard Lin Lingsu laugh and say: "Boy, with your little cultivation, can you plot against her?" His knees were numb, and he was hit by his air arrow, and he immediately knelt down on the gourd with a "thud".
He was shocked and annoyed. He didn't know why the two people suddenly let go of their past feud, joined hands to help each other, and said loudly: "Devil, you have come out, what are you waiting for? Miss Xiaoqing has no grudges against you, why drag her into the water? If you want to kill or chop her, just come to me."
Lin Lingsu smiled and said: "Young man cherishes beauty and cherishes jade. He is quite like me. Very good, very good." She grabbed his head, pushed him down in front of him, and said: "It's not that I won't let you go, it's that you are seeking your own death and can't escape. If you want to survive, kneel down and kowtow to me a few times, and worship me as your teacher."
Xu Xuan struggled hard, but his neck seemed to be tightly held by an iron hoop. Lin Lingsu said happily: "His grandma, there are countless people in the world who want to join my sect of Shenxiao. I made an exception to accept you, but you still push around. Kowtow."
Xu Xuan's back and neck sank, and he couldn't help but kowtow at him. Filled with shame and anger, he shouted: "I am an outside disciple of the Ge Xianren sect, how can I accept a devil like you as my teacher?" Just as he was about to stab with a knife, his veins were sore, and the Dragon Tooth Blade was snatched away by him again.
Lin Lingsu said solemnly: "Do you think I want to accept you as my disciple? That day in Qingyang Palace, I have taught you the "Five Thunder Mind Technique", which even Wang Wenqing has not fully understood. If you hadn't given me half a life-saving grace, I would have slapped you to death. Since I can't kill you, you have to be my disciple of Shenxiao.
Before he finished speaking, Xu Xuan's neck felt heavy again, and he kowtowed twice in a row. He was so angry that he wanted to explode, and shouted: "Devil, you killed Abbot Mingkong and Immortal Ge, and caused all my family to suffer. You caused the Song Dynasty to suffer this catastrophe. You are full of evil, and everyone and the gods are angry. Xu Xuan will never be your pawn even if the thunder hits the top and is buried in the belly of a fish. You can just kill me."
Lin Lingsu laughed loudly and said: "I have always repaid kindness with kindness and revenge with hatred. How could I do such a shameless thing of repaying kindness with hatred? You have already performed the ceremony of apprenticeship and memorized the Five Thunder Heart Techniques. You are now my direct disciple. There are thieves above and these bastards below. This can be proved. You can't deny it even if you want to."
As he spoke, neon lights billowed in the sky and thunder continued. The chaotic swords flew back and forth, spinning faster and faster around the "electric sword", turning into a dazzling spectacle like an aurora. They were hundreds of feet apart, but they had already stirred up huge waves and frequent whirlpools on the sea surface.
Wang Wenqing said calmly: "When yin and yang are combined, thunder is born. This young man is a pure yang body, and this snake demon is a yin body. Both of their meridians are broken, and the oil is exhausted. Do you want to use them to combine the 'Liangyi Thunder Sword'?"
Lin Lingsu smiled and said: "How can you kill a chicken with a sledgehammer? The Liangyi Thunder Sword of my wife and I is used to kill ghosts and gods. To deal with you, these two brats are more than enough."
He turned his head, looked at Li Shaowei with a smile, and said: "Husband and wife fall in love in bed, and they resist each other's insults. My dear dear wife, you and I have been fighting for decades, and now that we are old, we can't achieve any results no matter how hard we fight. It's better to compare whose apprentice is more effective."
These few words that the lady yelled seemed to be true, and Li Shaowei's eyes turned red, and tears almost came out of his eyes. I obviously know that he is unkind and unjust, and I hate him to the core, but when I listen to her and think of all the sweet words he said in the past, and the happy times together, I can't help but feel my ears burning, and feel the sweetness and bitterness in my ears.
She took a deep breath, smiled sweetly, and said: "Li Lang, Li Lang, when have I ever refused you to do something you want me to do?" She pinched Xiaoqing's cheeks open and popped a few pills in.
Xiao Qing felt a chill in her throat, as if she had swallowed ice, and then her Dantian was like lava spewing thin. Heat waves suddenly surged up. As her meridians swept through her body, the remaining chill disappeared instantly.
Li Shaowei withdrew his hands and said softly: "Girl, you have been practicing for five hundred years, but you have no idea. You have never been able to open up the two meridians of Ren and Du. These "Shangqing Weixiang Pills" can, on the one hand, intensify the "Nascent Soul Golden Pill" and relieve the cold poison of "Po Pollen" in your body; on the other hand, they can help you unblock your meridians. As long as you listen to me honestly, you can cultivate to the realm of "human immortal" in less than a year..."
Xiaoqing's dream was to get rid of the snake body and become an immortal. When he heard that the female devil was willing to help, most of his resentment towards her disappeared immediately, and he was pleasantly surprised.
Li Shaowei paused and then said: "If you are disobedient, that's up to you. However, once the 'Three Corpses Golden Thread Gu' in these pills becomes active, you will not be able to survive or die. Then don't blame me, the master, for not saving you." His lips moved, and he recited some incantation.
Xiaoqing's eyesight went dark, her heart was torn apart by thousands of knives, and she almost screamed out in pain. Being held hostage by her all the way, I had already seen all the ruthless methods of the Demon Queen. I knew that she would do what she said, so I gritted my teeth and thought to myself: "If I keep the green hills, I won't be afraid of running out of firewood. Anyway, the meridians of these two demons are severed, so they won't be able to hold on for long. As long as I can save my life tonight, are you afraid that I won't be able to cure the poison in the future and get the Heaven Refining Stone Map?"
At that moment, he knelt down and kowtowed to her, saying respectfully: "Thank you, Queen of Heaven, for saving my life. Being able to become a disciple of the guru is a blessing that Xiaoqing has cultivated for three lifetimes. It's too late to be happy, so how can you dare to disobey?"
Lin Lingsu smiled and said: "Boy, this goblin is much smarter than you. It seems that you need to eat a few 'yes-men' before you can become more honest."
Xu Xuan felt a pain in his cheek. He pinched his cheek and stuffed it without knowing what was inside. There was a numbness and itch in his throat, and it was really like a bug crawling through his mouth and falling straight into his stomach. Goosebumps spread all over her body, and she was shocked and angry, but he pinched her cheeks and couldn't vomit.
neonThe light was dancing wildly, the wind and waves were getting bigger and bigger, and in the thunder and rainstorm, Wang Wenqing's voice came word by word: "The five qi combine to form Taiyi. In today's battle, only one of the 'Taiyi Thunder Soldiers' and the 'Liangyi Electric Sword' can remain in the world. Back then, Mongolia Brother Linghe taught me the nameless mental method, and I have just begun to achieve it. Although you have hidden secrets that made me almost become a demon, I will always remember this first three swords in my heart as a token of gratitude."
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a "boom", swords burst into chaos, and rays of light rolled down half a mile away, immediately causing huge waves dozens of feet high.
The gourd was thrown up in a sudden spin and crashed into the raging waves. Xu Xuan's energy and blood surged wildly, and he was all kinds of meat and fish.
Lin Lingsu grabbed his shoulders tightly and laughed loudly: "Back then, when you were on Shennongjia, you were a sweet talker. I had already expected this day. I was just thinking of our sworn friendship. You would rather betray me than I will betray you. From Yanfu Palace, to Wuyi Jiuqu, from the coast of the East China Sea, to the top of Jiuhua Mountain, you have plotted against me more than three times? Why do you have to show off and let me sword you three times?"
Thunder roared, the sea surface exploded, and Wang Wenqing's second sword fell again.
This time it landed on the left side of the gourd, creating a huge wave that covered the sky and covered the earth. It was over a hundred feet high, and even the swimming sharks were lifted up.
Xiao Qing turned pale with shock, but Lin Lingsu roared loudly and shouted happily. She put her hands on Xu Xuan's back and said with a smile: "Boy, you and I have been like grasshoppers on the same rope for a long time. Be it the government, the court, or the Taoist and Buddhist sects. Well, I already regard you as my accomplice. You should obey me obediently and work together to kill these Tatars and Taoist priests. Maybe you can even save the lives of your parents." He stretched out his palms and poured in his true energy.
Li Shaowei also pressed against Xiaoqing's back and asked her to sit cross-legged across from Xu Xuan, with their palms touching each other. The four people lined up in a straight line, following the gourd spinning rapidly in the whirlpool.
Xu Xuan was filled with anger and wanted to curse, but the waves of energy in his body were so strong that he couldn't utter a single word.
Just listen to the buzzing sound transmission of the demon: "The mind is like chaos, the energy is like too empty, refine the energy to become the spirit, refine the spirit to become the Tao, the three gates and three fields, the water and the fire, the eight extraordinary meridians, the breath returns to the root..." The true energy rushes into the Dantian, like a turbine turning angrily, and the clothes are hunting and inspiring.
